title: McpServerDefinition
description: One MCP server: the standard mcp.json server entry with its alias and the scope of the root whose Agent Plugin carries it. A server the workspace adds is written as a one-server plugin at that scope.

name.title: McpServerName
name.description: The server's alias: its mcpServers member name, the runtime tag whose fence invokes it, and its resource scheme.

scope.title: McpServerScope
scope.description: The plugin root: project `.agents/plugins`, plurnk `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/plurnk/plugins`, or global `~/.agents/plugins`.

plugin.title: McpServerPlugin
plugin.description: The installed Agent Plugin that declares the server. The service records it; a client never supplies it.

data.description: PLUGIN_DATA: the plugin's persistent data directory.

type.description: A local server: a subprocess speaking MCP over its standard input and output.

command.description: One executable token: a bare name, or a path beginning with ./ that resolves against the plugin root.

args.description: Arguments passed to the executable; ${PLUGIN_ROOT} and ${PLUGIN_DATA} expand.

env.description: Environment variables supplied to the process; ${PLUGIN_ROOT} and ${PLUGIN_DATA} expand.

cwd.description: The working directory: ./, ${PLUGIN_ROOT} or ${PLUGIN_DATA} rooted; the plugin root when absent.

type.description: A remote server: an MCP endpoint over Streamable HTTP.

url.description: The MCP endpoint: HTTPS, or HTTP on a loopback host.

headers.description: Literal headers sent to the endpoint's own origin; a header the client generates overrides one of the same name.
